source: Water Quality Portal (WQP), legacy WQX 2.x web services
notes: San Bernardino County, California (FIPS 06071) chosen after a statewide site-summary scan: it has roughly ten times more repeatedly sampled wells for arsenic and nitrate than any Central Valley county.

The WQX3 'fullPhysChem' profile was tried for the same query on 2026-10-07 and returned 99 rows plus an 'ERROR: INCOMPLETE DATA' sentinel row versus 13,301 rows from the legacy profile. The legacy profile is used.
Both nitrate characteristic names are requested on purpose: they are different chemical definitions and the comparability question is part of the analysis.
